mutations.after: // mutated: the required-kind guard is gone
mutations.because: MP-D4: the last enabled instance of a required kind must be refused, or the editor hands the boundary a template it refuses to parse — an image-text brief whose only image is switched off leaves nothing to paint the ground. The offer is absent from the section and the refusal is in the reducer; removing it makes the toggle a way to build an unsaveable brief.
command: the last enabled required layer offers no toggle

mutations.before:
const draws = (layers: readonly CreativeTemplateLayer[]) =>
    layers.filter((layer) => layer.enabled !== false);
mutations.because: MP-D3: occlusion is evaluated over the enabled subset, because a disabled layer draws nothing and so occludes nothing. Computing it over the whole array leaves a notice standing for a layer that no longer paints (and silently swallows the notice when it is switched back on, since the pair never left the list).
